next.reason: 1985 GR10: no KEY -> prime key; KEY -> data-name-1's record key or the key whose leftmost position matches data-name-1's; used to order this START and, if successful, later sequential READs. §2023:14.9.41.4 GR15 ('the same as if KEY IS EQUAL TO data-name-1 or record-key-name-1 had been specified' with the prime key) and §2023:14.9.41.4 GR16 ('or that shares a leftmost character with the data item specified in the KEY phrase, becomes the key of reference'; used for subsequent sequential READs), with §2023:14.9.30.4 GR21 b) on the READ side. GR17 is the counterpart of 1985 GR4, not of this rule. record-key-name-1 is new syntax. Same.
